title: Plan view
rule: Straight-down overhead view of office and platform as a floor plan; people are hat-tops and shoulders, the walk a dotted track.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
made: every figure and object HANDMADE cut paper in code (films/swarm/99-ways/kit/cutpaper99.py: scissor-faceted flat papers with the LoC 1934 sheet's fibre as relative tone, one down-right paper shadow per piece)

one floor plan repeated in six panels: walls as dark cut strips (the plan's section line) with the ticket-window glass, counter and sill in the left wall and the SERVICE door shut flush in the top wall; office floorboards; the platform's boards and white edge; the track bed with ties and two rails

furniture from above: desk with the memo slip, inkwell and pencil, the chair, the cupboard (its top while shut; opened, its dark interior and the leaf swung 90 degrees on the left jamb with a dotted swing arc and the key on its inside face)

people from above: the agent as hair-top, nose tip, shirt shoulders with the waistcoat across the back, white sleeves, hands, shoes, yellow pencil; the stranger as a hat (brim, band, crown) on coat shoulders
his walk a growing track of punched paper dots from the chair round the desk, past the window, to the cupboard; her walk a finer track of small dots in and back out along the platform

draughtsman's detail circles with dashed leaders enlarge things lying flat or too small from above: the memo (P1), the clock face at 4:10 (P3), the key on its hook with its SERVICE tag (P5-P6); a dashed sight line from his head to the clock bracket (P3)
title block: 'PLAN: ticket office and platform, Randolph station, 4:09 to 4:11', the two-track legend, a cut scale bar and north arrow
lettering in the shared pen hand; the four canon lines in the shared cut-paper balloons (penlib.balloon_piece); hand-ruled borders (penlib.border_mask); folio '38 / Plan view' (pen99.folio)

events.E0: P1: he stands up from the chair at the desk, the memo enlarged in a detail circle; the first dots of his track
events.E1: P2: his track has rounded the desk to the counter; she stands at the glass outside; question balloon to her hat
events.E2: P3: a dashed sight line from his head to the clock bracket; the clock detail at 4:10; answer balloon
events.E3: P4: her small dots turn back up the platform; thanks balloon to her hat; his track bends toward the cupboard
events.E4: P5: the track ends at the cupboard; its leaf is swung open on the left jamb; key detail circle
events.E5: P6: pencil to his chin, forgetting balloon; the key still on its hook; SERVICE door shut flush in the wall

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: the dotted track grows panel by panel as the agent's hat-less head-top moves from the chair to the cupboard; the cupboard leaf swings open on its left jamb; the forgetting line ends the track
beat_frames: b01: E0 panel: he rises from the chair; the first dots of his track; she walks up the platform
b02: E1 panel: the dotted track has curved round the desk to the window; she stands at the glass
b04: E2 panel: he stops, a dotted sight line up to the clock bracket; detail circle at 4:10; the answer
b05: E3 panel: her small dots turn away up the platform; his track bends toward the cupboard; thanks
b06: E4 panel: his track reaches the cupboard, still shut (its top seen)
b07: the cupboard leaf swings open on its left jamb (dotted swing arc); key detail circle
b08: E5 panel: pencil to his chin, the forgetting line; the whole track ends at the open cupboard (= the page)

self_check.no_wall_standing: every wall is a cut strip seen from above in section; the clock, memo and key faces appear only inside detail circles (plan callouts), never as standing walls
self_check.path_as_line: his walk is one continuous dotted track, chair to cupboard, complete in P6
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker
